# Thanks for the interest

Thanks for taking an interest in these dotfiles.

This repo is public so you can read it, learn from it, and fork it freely, but it is my personal machine configuration and does not accept outside contributions.
Pull requests are auto-closed here so the repo can stay personal and predictable, and Issues are turned off for the same reason.

If you want to adapt something, or you have found something that would bite anyone who cloned this, please fork the repo and fix it there.
MIT No Attribution: you owe nothing back.
